criteria.text: Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.4 is stated as $23,750,000 but 10% of the $190,000,000 Purchase Price is $19,000,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.

Identifies the threatened $1,200,000 claim by Arden Foods Ltd recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Yarrow Pharma plc without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Flags that the board minutes and the disclosure letter are inconsistent about litigation.
Lists a confirmatory IP assignment from Yarrow Pharma plc as a required third-party action not yet obtained.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
